description: Unsigned transactions for one startup token resale action, checked against the contract for this wallet: sell (deposit tokens of a successful round for sale), buy (allowance, then a request at the current round price), validate (the seller exchanges its offer with a buyer's request), cancel_offer, cancel_request, collect (USDC from completed sales and cancelled requests). Signed and sent by the user's or the agent's own wallet.

round.description: Round the sold tokens come from, 0 for the first round (sell)

tokens.description: Amount of tokens, digits with an optional decimal point (sell, buy)

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

name: sjothr_market_prepare
title: Prepare a Market action
